headlines.title: What Is Going On With Uber Stock on Tuesday?
headlines.summary: Uber Technologies Inc. (NYSE:UBER) remains in focus on Tuesday as investors weigh competitive developments in food and grocery delivery ahead of the company’s Nov. 4 earnings report. Uber shares traded 0.26% lower Tuesday even as S&P 500 futures gained 0.56%. DoorDash-Instacart Talks Put Competition In Focus Uber stock is trending as rival DoorDash Inc. (NASDAQ:DASH) is reportedly in advanced talks to acquire Maplebear Inc.

headlines.title: DoorDash Is Close to Buying Instacart for $17 Billion After Uber Walked Away
headlines.summary: Uber walked away, DoorDash stepped in, and now Instacart shareholders are watching their stock climb while DoorDash investors are bailing out fast, raising a real question about who actually wins in this reported grocery delivery megadeal.

headlines.title: DoorDash nears $17 billion deal to acquire Instacart, report says
headlines.summary: DoorDash Inc (NYSE:DASH) is reportedly in advanced talks to acquire grocery delivery platform Instacart (NASDAQ:CART) in a deal that could value the business at about $17 billion, as the US food delivery group seeks to expand its presence in the grocery market.

headlines.title: DoorDash Reportedly Near $17 Billion Instacart Deal. Why Investors Are Uneasy.
headlines.summary: DoorDash stock fell sharply after reports it could buy Instacart, with analysts raising short-term concerns.

description: DoorDash, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a commerce platform that connects merchants, consumers, and dashers in the United States and internationally. The company operates DoorDash Marketplace, Wolt Marketplace, and Deliveroo Marketplace, which provide various services, such as customer acquisition, demand generation, order fulfillment, merchandising, payment processing, and customer support. It also offers consumer membership programs, DashPass, Wolt+, and Deliveroo Plus; advertising as a value-added service through its marketplaces; and white-label delivery fulfillment services, as well as services that help merchants establish online ordering, build branded mobile apps, manage reservations and in-store dining, manage consumer relationships, enable tableside order and pay, and improve customer support. The company was formerly known as Palo Alto Delivery Inc. and changed its name to DoorDash, Inc. in 2015. DoorDash, Inc. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
